name: Dioo Microcircuits Co., Ltd. Jiangsu
summary: Dioo Microcircuits Co., Ltd. Jiangsu engages in the research, development, design, manufacture, and sale of high- integrated circuit chips in China and internationally. The company's products portfolio includes operational amplifiers, analog switches, level shifters, comparators, current and other sensors, class D audio amplifiers, audio/video drivers, USB redrivers, CAN FD transceivers, chargers, high side derivers, TEC controllers, AC/DC converters, load switches, general power management products, power modules, and DC/DC converters.
